strengths.finding: The hand changes solve actual contour crowding through posing. Thinking's free mitten now sits away from the chin contact; focused separates its low mittens; grateful preserves an intentional lower clasp instead of packing it into the ruff; worried has a clearer diagonal relationship. Both themes retain the same compact character.

The offering mitten moves outward and turns after the return toward the visitor, then holds. The sampled sequence reads as one change of hand orientation rather than a repeating wave, and the unchanged short arm remains connected. The larger final portrait makes this change visible without growing the hand or torso.

Composition mapping is narrow and reusable within this study: measured heading bearing accounts for SVG letterboxing, only gaze/head channels change during investigation, and the authored visitor return is restored by2350ms. Current phone samples have upward attention rather than the previous fixed sideways address, while the desktop pose stays close to the authored composition.

The new layout-dependent state respects the existing playback model. Layout reads are isolated from character frames; paused resize stays frozen; replay carries the displayed correction; staging advances only with the clip; theme changes reuse the same rendered pose. These address likely integration faults rather than merely checking fixed constants.

The preserved renderer and constrained poses still produce coherent wings, antennae, feet and mitten connections in the inspected sheets. There is no sampled clipping or detached-part regression. Existing neutral application construction remains supported by the unchanged character and neutral pose; this review does not invent a new export drawing.
